sources.note: Electro-Voice RE50/B data sheet (official, 1/2008 Telex edition, downloaded, text read, the page-2 dimension drawing rendered from its vector paths): length 197 mm (7.75 in.), max diameter 49 mm (1.94 in.), shank diameter 25 mm (1.0 in.). Connector: 3-pin XLR male. realSizeMm: w = d = 49 (widest diameter), h = 197 (length), upright with the XLR base end down (same convention as the shure-sm58 spec).

Silhouette profile in mic-profiles.json: read from the vector dimension drawing on page 2 of the same data sheet (outline coordinates from the PDF path data, scale from the labelled 197 mm and checked against the labelled 49 mm: drawn ring 48.9 mm). The drawn handle measures 26.3 mm against the 25 mm label (the 25 mm arrows span 27.1 mm at scale), so about 5 percent doubt on the handle diameter.

out-xlr: the catalog has one port, the male XLR. It sits on the bottom (XLR base end) face at its centre (x = y = 24.5 mm). The drawing shows a body of revolution with the XLR end at the right, so the connector position is by geometry (concentric): confidence photo. openingMm is left out (not published). The catalog lists no controls for the RE50B.

build.profile (rebuilt 2026-11-10, Wave 4 Task 4.1): silhouette of assets-source/ev-re50/photos/front.png (331 x 1429, transparent background, side-on, upright) read row by row (alpha mask, radius from the median axis), height scale 197 mm over the 1429 px, diameters x1.080 so the widest (the rim) is the 49 mm of the data sheet, then simplified by hand to 37 stations. The photo agrees with the data-sheet drawing on every axial position (flare starts 139.5 against 140.1, rim at 170 against 170.4 to 174.5, top at 197) and on the handle (25.8 mm against the 26.3 drawn and the 25 labelled); it differs on the head, which is a convex bowl in the photo (43.6 mm at 154.5) where the coarse 16-station drawing is a straight cone (about 38 mm there), so the photo curve is kept. Accuracy about +/-0.4 mm (1 px = 0.14 mm). build.colours: near-black handle and head from the photo (sRGB about 30-45), lifted by the builder.

build.projection wrap: the surface picture is our own generic artwork (content/generic-panels/ev-re50.json, asset:panel): an unrolled 153.94 x 197 mm panel with a plain handle, a plain neck band where the real mic carries a badge, a rim ring and a diamond weave on the windscreen above the rim (100 cells around so it repeats at the seam). It copies no photo and carries no brand mark or lettering; the weave pitch is stylised, not measured.
